title: TokenResponse
description: OAuth 2.0 token response containing the access token and refresh token for subsequent API calls.

access_token.description: Bearer token for authenticating subsequent API requests.

refresh_token.description: Token for obtaining a new access token when the current one expires.

expires_in.description: Number of seconds until the access token expires.

scope.description: Scope of access granted by the token.

token_type.description: Type of token issued, typically Bearer.
